subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about completed-booking acquisition. Since Expedia struck its deal to embed hotel bookings inside the Uber super app this year, distribution in your tier is shifting toward high-intent surfaces, and US guest acquisition cost still runs 15 to 20 percent of room revenue. That is the band where booking-event screening and incrementality decide your real cost per validated stay. We hold out a control group so paid bookings show as incremental to the organic travelers you would have closed anyway. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely Expedia-Uber super app distribution shift (sourced) + US guest acquisition cost band
